issues.description: New Metadata specification import is added as another standalone same-crate import.
issues.rationale: Independent base diff corrects first-pass premise: vstd_extra::array_ptr at18 is inherited and must not be blamed on this PR. The PR adds a new standalone crate::specs::mm::frame::meta_owners::Metadata import at21 adjacent to same-crate spec imports22-25, adding another split import instead of joining the verification group. Accepted scope is this new Metadata import only.
